## iPadn 2.0.0

iPadn 2.0 是一次大更新：新增发现页、用户评论、翻译、应用锁、本机应用、Wi‑Fi 传输、灵动岛下载进度、小组件和快捷指令，原生安装可以阻止 App Store 更新，并开始支持 iOS / iPadOS 16。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

**两个安装包**

- `iPadn-2.0.0-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，包含实时活动（灵动岛、锁屏）和小组件，签名时需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.0.0-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID，适合 App ID 数量有限的签名方式。其他功能相同。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可以添加源 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`，在工具里直接安装和更新。

**发现与应用详情**

- 搜索页新增「发现」：免费榜、付费榜、畅销榜，可切换地区并按分类筛选。
- 详情页新增「评论」，可查看各地区最近的用户评论并按星级筛选。
- 简介和更新说明不是你的语言时，可以用系统翻译替换为译文（iOS 17.4 及更新版本）。
- 版本历史默认显示最近 5 个版本。

**下载与安装**

- 锁屏和灵动岛显示下载进度（可在设置中关闭）。
- 新增「仅使用 Wi‑Fi 下载」和「下载完成后自动安装」。
- 下载页可以「全部更新」，编辑模式改为紧凑列表并支持全选。
- 任务详情新增「安装包信息」：权限、扩展、语言、URL Scheme、后台模式等。
- 原生安装新增「阻止 App Store 更新」：App Store 会把应用视为最新版本，不再提示或自动更新；关闭后再安装一次即可恢复（#46）。
- 新增「账号 › 本机应用」：列出手机上已装的应用，对比 App Store 版本并一键全部更新（需要原生安装的配对）。
- 新增「账号 › Wi‑Fi 传输」：在同一 Wi‑Fi 的电脑浏览器中下载已完成的安装包，只在页面打开时运行，地址带随机密钥。
- 在 LiveContainer 中运行时，会提示打开 LiveContainer 的「修复文件导入」，之后才能导入导出文件和一键安装（#44）。

**关注与价格**

- 关注的付费应用可以设置目标价，降到目标价才提醒。

**安全与快捷操作**

- 新增应用锁：面容 ID、触控 ID 或密码，可设置离开多久后需要验证，多任务界面中也会隐藏内容。
- 新增主屏幕和锁屏小组件：快速打开搜索、下载、已购和更新检查。
- 新增快捷指令：下载应用、检查更新、下载全部更新、获取下载进度、暂停或继续全部下载、关注应用。

**专业模式**

- 可以对比同一应用的两个已下载版本：版本、权限、扩展、框架等变化。

**设置**

- 设置首页改为分类入口；新增「备份与维护」导出、导入设置和关注列表（不含账号和安装包）。
- 关闭「新版本提醒」后，下载页也不再显示更新提示。

**系统支持与稳定性**

- 支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本（感谢 @tageniu）。
- 修复部分安装包（如网易云音乐）的图标导致 iPadn 启动后崩溃。
- 切换标签页更流畅：不再每次重建所有页面（#41）。

**English**

iPadn 2.0 adds Discover (top charts by region and category), customer reviews, system translation of descriptions and release notes, App Lock, Apps on This Device, Wi‑Fi transfer to a computer, download progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, widgets and Shortcuts actions. Downloads can wait for Wi‑Fi and install automatically when finished; native installation can block App Store updates for an app. Package info shows what a package declares, and Pro mode compares two downloaded versions. Followed paid apps can have a target price, settings are grouped into pages with backup export and import, and iOS / iPadOS 16 is now supported. Releases include a lite package without the app extension that needs a single App ID. Also fixes a launch crash caused by some packages' icons and makes tab switching smoother.

更早版本的更新内容见 [Releases](https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn/releases)。

两个安装包：`iPadn-2.0.0-unsigned.ipa` 是标准版（含实时活动和桌面小组件，需要 2 个 App ID）；`iPadn-2.0.0-lite-unsigned.ipa` 是精简版（不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID），适合 App ID 数量受限的签名方式。

验证：设备 Release 编译与 IPA 检查通过；145 项测试通过，0 项失败，0 项跳过。

apps.localizedDescription:
## v0.15.2 Highlights

A polish release. Voice input is steadier, you can tidy up chats faster, phones get better model controls, and the desktop app now shows what each update changes.

## New Contributors
* @Siq5005 made their first contribution in https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi/pull/3400
* @mothieras made their first contribution in https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi/pull/3428
* @Goldloli made their first contribution in https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi/pull/3411
* @FoolKc made their first contribution in https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi/pull/3433

### Product updates

#### Chat and voice

- You can now delete many conversations at once. Press the select button next to "New conversation", pick rows or use "Select all", then press "Delete" twice to confirm.
- The "Turns to remember" setting now keeps whole turns. A turn is your message plus the character's replies. Before, small limits could drop the last reply or switch between partial history and only your newest message. Now the oldest whole turns go first.
- Bold and italic text next to Chinese or Japanese punctuation now shows correctly. Before, text such as `**测试。**测试` showed the asterisks, and text-to-speech read them aloud.
- If you use OpenRouter with the Responses API and a model that accepts audio, your voice messages now reach the model as audio. Before, the model got only the transcript.
- The official AIRI chat provider now uses the Responses API by default, with built-in web search. You can switch back to Chat Completions in the provider settings.

#### Models and stage

- When you upload a display model to your account, the model card now shows a percent and a progress bar. Uploads can be up to 512 MiB, so you can now see that a big upload is still moving.
- On phones, the model settings now support two-finger zoom. The View menu and the model settings use the same size and position rulers. We also removed the extra vertical slider.
- The background picker now follows your app language, in all ten supported languages.

#### Account and sync

- Account settings have a new **Sync** section. It has a switch for each kind of synced data: chats, provider settings (with API keys), character cards, and Live2D and VRM models. All four are on by default. A switch is per device. Turning one off pauses sync for that device and deletes nothing. Character card sync and model sync are no longer experimental features. If you turned one off before, it stays off.
- The "Capacitor" entry and page are now called **Subscription**, and "Install" is now **Subscribe**. Capacitor stays as the plan name inside the page. Purchased Flux now shows as your **Flux balance**.

#### Desktop app

- The About page now shows what an update changes. A **What's new** button opens the release notes for the new version. Nightly and dev builds show a link to the code changes instead. The **Confirm Restart** button now looks like a primary action, so it no longer blends into the card.
- On macOS, AIRI now asks for its own permissions, even when a terminal, Steam, or another launcher starts it. Before, Beat Sync could get only silence and show "No audio detected", even though AIRI had already been given permission. If this happened to you, give screen and system audio recording permission to AIRI itself.
- In the IO tracer devtools window, the top tab bars now act as the title bar. On macOS, the window buttons no longer cover the first tab, and you can drag the window by the empty part of the tab bar. On Windows and Linux, the window buttons are back.

### Bug fixes

- **Characters stopped replying after a wake word conflict.** If a character tried to set a wake word that another character already used, the reply failed with a `structuredClone` error. The character now replies and tells you about the conflict.
- **Voice input could get stuck without any error.** If the speech provider never finished the transcript, the input waited forever, and nothing was sent

Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, and N64.

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Sega Genesis
• And plenty more to come!

Controller Support
• Supports PS4, PS5, Xbox One S, Xbox Series X, and MFi game controllers.
• Supports bluetooth (and wired) keyboards, as well as the Apple Smart Keyboard.
• Completely customize button mappings on a per-system, per-controller basis.
• Map buttons to special “Quick Save”, “Quick Load,” and “Fast Forward” actions.

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.

• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats

• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark

Delta Sync

• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
• Supports animated buttons for even more immersion when playing games

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (ex: run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
• Customize speed per-game by long-pressing Fast Forward option in pause menu.

3D/Haptic Touch

Game Artwork

RetroAchievements

• Shows your achievement progress when launching a game

Misc.

• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

• Run any Operating System

• High Compatibility
iOS 14+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12

LiveContainer 3.8.0 
> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires SideStore 0.6.2+ or AltStore 2.2.1+ for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore ("LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa"), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details. 
New Features 
Storage Management 
• Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
• Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
• Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches. 
Multiple LiveContainers
• Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (1367) 
Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (1357) 
Multitasking 
• Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (1208)
• Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (1228, 1250)
• Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
• URL schemes and "open-url" payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows. 
JIT
• Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler. 
TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN 
Improvements
• Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (1194)
• IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
• Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
• Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
• Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
• Add a "Clear Notification" button (1388)
• Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (1417) 
Bug Fixes 
• Fixed "livecontainer://open-url" dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (1339)
• Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (1209)
• Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an "en.lproj" path. (1239)
• Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (1365, 1368)
• Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (1347)
• Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (1386)
• Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (1430)
• Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (1300, 1310, 1329)
• Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (1402, 844, 870)
• Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (1394, 1417, 1416)
• Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (1415) 
Localization 
• Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS 
Credits 
Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN. 
Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

Bug Fixes 
• Fix an issue where built-in SideStore may freeze on launch (1158)
• Fix the ipa of another LiveContainer not generating in LiveContainer+SideStore builds after SideStore's massive codebase change (1184)
• Fix the new Launch App Shortcut does not work below iOS 18 (1159)

New Features

LiveContainer 3.7.0 
> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires SideStore 0.6.2+ or AltStore 2.2.1+ for installation.
> We recommend installing LiveContainer + SideStore using [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details. 
Happy Spring Festival / Lunar New Year! After six months of development, we’re excited to release LiveContainer 3.7.0. This update introduces several powerful new features, including the Launch App Shortcut, iOS 26 JIT script support, external containers, native icon generation, and more. 

New Features 
Launch App Shortcut 
> [!Note]
> This feature requires LiveContainer to be installed with at least the LaunchAppExtension and LaunchAppExtensionHelper extension. iOS 16+ is supported. 
A new extension allows apps to launch instantly without opening the LiveContainer main interface (for apps that are not locked, hidden, or JIT-required). Once configured, the shortcut prepares the runtime environment and selects an available LiveContainer instance to launch the app directly. 
This reduces extra relaunches and jumps and typically saves 1~2 seconds per launch. 
See the [setup guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/guides/add-to-home-screen) for instructions. 
JIT 
Support for iOS 26 JIT scripts has been added by @Vishal. Scripts can be configured in app-specific settings and loaded automatically on iOS 26+. 
The “StikDebug in another LiveContainer” option has been fixed, allowing StikDebug to run within LiveContainer. When launching a JIT-required app, LiveContainer will automatically detect StikDebug, launch it in an available container, and pass all required parameters — including scripts — to enable JIT. 
In addition, when enabling JIT for multitasked app, LiveContainer will prioritize launching StikDebug as a multitask app to save app slot usage. (TODO: this doesn’t automatically minimize StikDebug after enabling JIT, might be added later) 
Be sure to convert StikDebug into a shared app before use. 

External Containers 
> [!Note]
> Containers stored on external media (portable drives, SMB shares, etc.) are unsupported by many apps and may cause instability or crashes. 
You can now use external folders as app containers. This is useful if you want to manage app data through a file manager while still accessing it in LiveContainer, or if you want maintain container access when an app is shared. 
To configure this, open: 
App-Specific Settings → Select External Data Folder 
Native Icons 
LiveContainer now generates icons using native iOS libraries. On iOS 18+, this enables proper Light, Dark, and Original (Liquid Glass) icon rendering. These icons can also be saved for home screen shortcuts. 
Multitasking Improvements 
* Added “Skip app terminate screen” (by @boa-z)
* Added ”Single Window Mode” to minimize other apps when a maximized app is brought to front
* Launch URL schemes can now be passed to multitasking apps. Passing URL between multitask apps can be controlled via ”Redirect URL to Host” switch
* Launching Private Apps is now possible. By default, apps launched with private container is only given sandbox access to its own data container folder. You can change it in developer settings.
* Changed animations a little bit 
AltStore Source Support 
Basic AltSource support has been implemented by @StephenDev0. Sources can be added using: 
"""
livecontainer://sources?url=
""" 
Other Additions 
* App remarks are now supported (by @WingCH)
* Decrypted apps can now be installed via "itms-services" links (by @WingCH) 
Bug Fixes 
* Fixed iOS 26.4b1 compatibility (1152)
* Fixed crashes caused by "-[NSUserDefaults synchronize]" returning NO
* Fixed signing crashes when apps contain too many libraries (1135)
* Fixed signing failure when not enough space is available to insert HM_DYLIB in Mach-O headers (951)
* Fixed signing issues when bundle IDs contain emoji (1130)
* Fixed some apps getting incorrect status bar height (759)
* Fixed malfunctions after clearing cache or removing the TEMP directory (1040, 1125, 884)
* Game mode is now disabled by default (can be enabled by reinstalling another LiveContainer instance)
* Fixed incorrect handling of "sidestore://" URLs
* Fixed WebKit cookie persistence issues (888)
* Improved multitasking dock tap responsiveness
* Fixed playback interruptions in multitasking PiP mode
* Improved app list color tinting to be always readable 
Removed Features
* 32-bit app support: @khanhduytran0 currently don’t have time for LiveExec32 R&D yet, contributions welcome. We might rollback later using an existing engine such as touchHLE.
